cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because it's raining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's had an extension before.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The handbook says lock the hall at six. Our festival permit says stay open till eight. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. So the permit governs public access, and the handbook governs everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we canceling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who gets the head seat: Grandma or the birthday child? We have traditions for both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put two chairs there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Which tradition decides who gets served first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.text: Then choose before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I can divide the pudding once somebody's had the wish.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before I leave for my shift, how much lasagne will you save me? Family custom says 'a proper portion.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't say how big.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then I'll find out what 'proper' means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brothers want seconds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save mine before you serve those. I'd like being expected home to count before being hungry twice.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?

beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please drop the request for a private tea queue. Everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent. Can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.
